30 Judges Appointed to Four High Courts

Thirty judges have been appointed to four High Courts across India. Among the newly appointed judges, 20 are advocates. The appointments were made to the High Courts of Telangana, Gujarat, and Bombay, and the Madras High Court. This action aims to fill judicial vacancies.
